Game Center with Kim
After class, go to the Game Center with Kim: inviting, counting times (~kai) and tickets (~mai), and saying what you want (~ga hoshii).

Oh, good work today! Class was tough, wasn't it?
Yes, it was hard. But it was fun.
Good work to you too.
It was difficult. (wrong grammar)
Haha, I make that mistake all the time! It's 「むずかしかったです」. Let's do our best together.
Hey, are you free after this? Want to go to the Game Center?
Sounds good. Let's go!
Sorry, today is a bit…
Want to go to the Game Center? (repeating the question)
Haha, that's my question! You answer with 「はい、行きましょう」 or 「すみません」.
I see. How about tomorrow then? You can practise numbers with the games!
Tomorrow is fine. Let's go.
The next day, after class, you went to the Game Center with Kim.
You walked along Sakura-dori with Kim to the Game Center.
The Game Center is full of sound and light.
Which one shall we play? There's the UFO catcher, basketball and Kana Rain.
Let's play basketball.
The UFO catcher sounds good.
I eat the game. (wrong verb)
Haha, you don't eat games! For games you say 「します」.
In basketball you throw the ball three times. Let's count together. Once, twice…
Three times!
Three (things)!
Close! Objects are 「みっつ」, but throws are 「さんかい」.
The ball went in twice! Five tickets came out.
With the UFO catcher you press the button twice. Which plush do you want?
I want that panda.
I want that panda. (wrong particle)
I used to say 「を」 too. But 「ほしい」 goes with 「が」.
Once, twice… you pressed the button. You caught the panda!
Now it's my turn. …Oh, total failure! Haha.
It's okay. Let's try one more time.
That's a shame.
You're bad at it.
Ugh… But it's okay to make mistakes! Our teacher said so too.
You took the tickets to the prize counter.
This sticker costs five tickets. How many do you have?
I have five. The sticker, please.
I have five (things).
Tickets are thin, so you count them with 「まい」. It's 「五まい」.
You got the sticker — a matching one with Kim's.
Today was fun! Let's come again together.
Yes, let's come again. Thank you.
See you.
Today's points: ~masen ka (inviting), ~mashou (let's), ~kai (times), ~mai (flat things), ~ga hoshii desu (I want). The Game Center is your place now!
